title: It's an ok stool
text: It's an ok stool. This seems like a nice stool. I'm ok with it for what it is for. I'm sad that the vinyl has a spot that didn't get secured because it is too short on one side so the white foam was showing. I need it right now or I would send it back. I glued it. Not pretty but it works.

product_metadata.title: 24-Inch Counter Height Bar Stool – Backless Folding Chair with 300lb Capacity for Kitchen, Recreation Room, or Game Room by Trademark Home (Red) Set of 1
features: COMPACT AND FOLDABLE- This 24-inch tall bar stool folds flat for convenient storage in small spaced when it isn’t being used. It also measures just 13” wide, making it perfect for dorms and apartments.

300 POUND CAPACITY- The base of this collapsible stool is constructed from 1mm-thick steel tubing for strength and durability. The heavy-duty frame gives the seat a 300-pound weight limit so both children and adults can comfortably use it.

EASY TO CLEAN- This bar stool has extra thick, PVC covered cushioning to provide a comfortable seat. The PVC cover is also easy to clean with a soft, damp cloth or sponge and soapy water. The seat should be dried completely before its next use.

PORTABLE- This foldable seat is designed to be lightweight and compact enough to easily take anywhere. Once folded, the stool easily fits in almost any vehicle for convenient travel to parties and family gatherings.

PRODUCT DETAILS- Materials: PVC and Steel. Open Dimensions: 14” L x 14” W x 24” H. Folded Dimensions: 13.5”W x 2.5” Thick x 35.5” H. Seat Diameter: 14.25”. Color: Red. 300 Pound Weight Capacity. Intended For Indoor Use Only.
